name: Fox
anatomy: a slim body with a pointed wedge muzzle, two tall triangular ears as stepped cube stacks, four short legs clearly separated, and a very thick bushy tail rendered as one solid slab lying flat along its right side with a white tip
colors: rust orange body, white chest and muzzle, black lower legs, black nose

name: Pig
anatomy: a big rounded barrel body, a short thick snout as a flat cube block, small floppy ears as flat slabs, four stubby legs clearly separated, no tail
colors: pale pink body, slightly darker pink snout and hooves

name: Sheep
anatomy: a huge puffy wool body rendered as solid stepped cube layers, a small dark head poking out the front, four thin-but-solid dark legs at least two cubes thick and clearly separated, no tail
colors: cream white wool, charcoal black face and legs

name: Cow
anatomy: a long boxy body, a blocky head with a wide flat muzzle, two small horn nubs as single cubes, four sturdy legs clearly separated, a pink udder slab underneath, tail omitted
colors: white body with large irregular black patches, pink muzzle and udder, dark hooves

name: Goat
anatomy: a compact body, a narrow head with two short backward-curving horns as stepped cube stacks, a small beard as a cube block under the chin, four sturdy legs clearly separated, tail a tiny stub cube
colors: light grey-brown body, darker brown legs and face stripe, cream belly

name: Cat
anatomy: a rounded body, a big round head with two triangular ears as stepped cubes, four short legs clearly separated, and a thick tail rendered as a solid slab curling flat against its left side
colors: grey tabby with darker grey stripes as flat bands, white paws and chest, pink nose

name: Capybara
anatomy: a long loaf-shaped body, a large blunt rectangular head with tiny ears as single cubes, four short sturdy legs clearly separated, no tail
colors: warm brown body, slightly lighter tan belly, dark brown nose

name: Wolf
anatomy: a lean powerful body, a long blocky muzzle, two upright pointed ears as stepped cubes, four long straight legs clearly separated, and a thick tail as a solid slab hanging straight down behind the hind legs, fused to the rump
colors: grey body with a darker grey back and lighter grey face and belly, black nose

name: Panda
idea: a giant panda on all fours
anatomy: a very round heavy body, a big round head with two round black ears as cube blocks, black eye patches as flat squares, four thick black legs clearly separated, no tail
colors: white head and body, black ears, eye patches, legs and a black band across the shoulders

name: Hippo
anatomy: an enormous barrel body, a huge wide flat rectangular head and muzzle, tiny ears as single cubes, four thick short pillar legs clearly separated, no tail
colors: grey-purple body, pink undertones on the belly and muzzle, dark toes
